en: A sepia-toned photograph of a World War I memorial monument set in an urban square. The monument consists of a tall stone pedestal and obelisk with a dramatic sculptural group of a rearing horse and several human figures in combat posed around it. Behind the monument stands a grand historicist-style building and leafless trees, suggesting late autumn or winter. The caption at the bottom margin reads in German: "Graz, Kriegerdenkmal der Universitätshörer."
